solution.what: Replayed 137 groups and checked the linked March front, June front and June reverse. March is a consistency check.

Integration review (AI agent, for the maintainers): fetched the CEHM visor fronts of the 1914 records listed with these in catalogue 1462. CMXV.35.3433.1-2 (27 Jul 1914) and CMXV.35.3492.2-3 (24 Aug 1914) are two-digit group telegrams with clear words between, untranscribed; CMXV.35.3464.1 (2 Aug 1914) is a plain-word code telegram. A glance at the first line of 3433.1-2 with the June values gave no Spanish; not a test. Next step: transcribe both and test the March and June keys on them.
